messages:
anna: Quick sync request — we need to lock down acceptance criteria and launch gating for enterprise audit evidence + retention. Customers are asking for BYOK handshake timing + export SLA. Can we get a short checklist?

mike: +1. high level: retention tiers, export SLA (time-to-download), format, and legal-hold behavior. also cost impact estimate.

lina: For acceptance criteria, suggest minimal cut:
- Audit logs available for 90 days (hot) with searchable indexing
- Export package (signed zip) within 30 minutes for up to 100GB
- BYOK handshake completed within onboarding window (no more than 48h human step)
- Legal hold flag prevents deletion/TTL applies to cold archive only
- Evidence schema versioned + manifest for chain-of-custody
Anyone object? :thinking_face:

dan: Technical notes: indexing 90d hot + 1y cold will blow storage costs unless we compress + sample. For export SLA, 30m for 100GB requires orchestrated snapshot streaming + parallel upload. We should define max concurrent exports to protect serving.

priya: From legal: we need proof of integrity for exported evidence (hashes), audit trail of who requested export, and explicit consent text in onboarding. Also cross-region export rules for EU customers (data residency).

mike: Ops tradeoff callout: if we allow immediate BYOK key import then we must support key rotation/revocation policy in the handshake. Otherwise customers expect deterministic behavior on rekey.

anna: Shortlist of launch MUSTs (proposal):
1) 90d searchable audit logs + 365d cold retention (configurable)
2) BYOK initial handshake + documented rollback path (manual approval)
3) Export: signed manifest + SHA256 hashes + 30m SLA for < 50GB, best-effort > 50GB
4) Legal hold toggle + retention override API
5) Telemetry: per-export latency + success/failure metrics exposed in Console
If we agree, we can move to sizing + runbook.

lina: I like the <50GB SLA bucket. Can we add an acceptance test: automated export of 25GB within staging in under 25m? That gives us pre-launch signal.

dan: Yep. I'll add a CI job that spins a snapshot, streams to staging export infra, and measures end-to-end. Patch note: need temporary increased IOPS in staging for that test.

priya: One more: include a retention exception workflow for legal teams (manual freeze + audit trail) as part of the MVP. Otherwise customers will push back.

mike: Cost ask: product should include a clear unit cost model for archive vs hot search + projected monthly bill for a 100TB customer. Without that sales will be blocked.

anna: Action items:
- dan: prototype export CI + estimate infra delta (due EOW)
- lina: write acceptance test matrix + sample runbook (due Tue)
- priya: draft legal hold UX copy + compliance checklist (due Tue)
- mike: comp cost model and pricing implications (due Fri)

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-4621: "Enterprise evidence export SLA + retention gating". Link: https://redwood.example/t/PROD-4621

lina: ok — who wants to be owner for launch checklist? I'll volunteer to shepherd acceptance tests.

anna: assigning lina as launch checklist owner. I'll coordinate stakeholder review next Thurs. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
